coordinate_frame: scan 001 NIfTI qform RAS+ millimetres; positive RAS Y is the anterior coordinate direction.
method: For each surface vertex, inverse-transform RAS to IJK and map to a half-voxel integer lattice. Group vertices by identical (I,K) lattice columns, take maximum RAS Y within each label column as its anterior-facing envelope, intersect exact Patella/Femur column keys, then report distribution of Patella minus Femur anterior-facing Y. Run the same descriptive comparison for Tibia without a pass gate.

predictions_before_analysis.tibia: Descriptive only; no threshold or pass criterion.

purpose: Quantify whether the source-labelled Patella surface lies anterior to same-scan distal Femur surface where their projected voxel columns overlap.
stopping_and_exclusion_rules: Do not alter or re-register meshes or voxel labels.
If the femur overlap count is below 100 or median anterior offset is not positive, report the prediction as failed.
This is only relative source-label geometry in one automatic-segmentation participant, not Numi-subject registration, expert anatomy approval, mechanics or clinical evidence.
